main_text.p: se brevi Lexicon quod paratum habet editu-rum: Interim quisque ex libris Persicis, ut Ro-fario Persico, Pentateucho Persico, aliisque li-bris Lexicon in proprium usum, per collatio-nem locorum conficiat.
main_text.head: Exercitatio lectionis Persicae, ex Gen. 1. ver. 1.
main_text.l: در اول آفريد خدا مر آن آسمان [?]
ofomân ân mer Chodâ aphrîd âwal Der
بود زمین و آن زمین [?] ان ومر [?]
boud zemîn vôân zemîn ân vomèr
روی و ویران و تاریکی ابر [?]
نهوم وادی هدایی و روح سوا آب [?]
aber schovâ vezîdeh Chodâji vobâdi tehoum

page.notes: The Persian lines are copied from a small, low-resolution scan. Their Arabic-script letters are uncertain and marked [?]; the transliterations and Latin glosses are the more reliable reading. The Latin paragraph at the top begins with "se" (long s read as plain s). The Latin glosses show "Persica" with the long s in print. "Introductio" stands at the lower left, not the right, so it is recorded as a catchword with some doubt. The gloss "&" marks are read as printed.
